captions.instagram:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone.

65.9% scored good, 90 or more, for SEO. Only 12.8% scored good for performance, the speed score. 27.3% scored poor on speed, under 50.

Plenty of sites get the basics right for Google and still keep people waiting on a phone.

captions.linkedin:
In our test of 12,621 Australian small-business websites (Google Lighthouse, one mobile run each), the four category scores told very different stories.

Share of sites scoring good, 90 or more:
SEO 65.9%
Best practices 51.6%
Accessibility 36.9%
Performance 12.8%

The SEO score checks the basics Google needs to read a page. The performance score is about how fast the page shows up on a phone, and that is the one most sites miss: 27.3% scored poor, under 50.

It is a lab test on a simulated mid-range phone, so it runs tough. Still, a page that ranks and then opens slowly loses people at the door.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research
